description: iOS framework → HarmonyOS NEXT kit mapping for IPA migration analysis

framework_mappings.note: Google Maps → @kit.MapKit. MapView, markers, polylines, routing all available natively in HarmonyOS.
Google ML Kit vision features (text recognition, face detection, barcode) → @kit.CoreVisionKit + @kit.ScanKit.
Firebase Analytics event tracking → @kit.AnalyticsKit (HiAppEvent). Custom events, user properties, funnel analysis all supported.
Firebase initialization → migrate Firebase app config to AGC (AppGallery Connect) initialization via @kit.AnalyticsKit.
Crash reporting → @kit.PerformanceAnalysisKit. JsError, native crash, and ANR detection available via HiAppEvent SDK.
FCM push notifications → @kit.PushKit. Token registration, message handling, topic subscription all map directly.
Firebase Auth → @kit.AccountKit. HUAWEI ID, phone/email auth, token management supported; social providers require reimplementation.
Firestore NoSQL cloud DB → AGC Cloud DB (@kit.CloudFoundationKit). Schema and query model differ; data migration required.
Firebase RTDB → AGC Cloud DB or Cloud Storage. Real-time sync requires AGC Cloud Functions or custom WebSocket layer.
Remote Config → AGC Remote Configuration. Key-value config, A/B testing, and conditions available via AGC platform.
Firebase Storage → AGC Cloud Storage. Upload, download, and metadata APIs align well with AGC equivalents.
Alamofire HTTP client → @kit.NetworkKit. HTTP/HTTPS requests, interceptors, and multipart upload all supported.
AFNetworking → @kit.NetworkKit. Session management, request serialization, and response validation available.
Moya (Alamofire wrapper) → @kit.NetworkKit. Same underlying HTTP primitives; type-safe request layer must be rewritten in ArkTS.
SDWebImage async load + disk cache → @kit.ImageKit. URL-based loading, cache eviction, and progressive decode all available.
Kingfisher → @kit.ImageKit. Disk + memory cache, animated GIF support, and downsampling all supported in ImageKit.
Nuke pipeline → @kit.ImageKit. Cache management APIs differ in detail; pipeline priority and prefetching need adaptation.
Realm object store → @kit.RelationalStoreKit (RDB). Schema migration required; Realm live-objects model differs from SQL rows.
Realm Swift API → @kit.RelationalStoreKit (RDB). Full data layer rewrite needed; async query and change notification APIs differ.
FMDB SQLite → @kit.RelationalStoreKit. Standard SQL queries, transactions, and migrations map directly to RDB APIs.
Charts → @kit.ArkUI Canvas + built-in chart components. ArkUI provides Line, Bar, and Pie chart components natively.
Lottie JSON animations → @kit.ArkUI Lottie component. HarmonyOS ArkUI includes native Lottie playback support out of the box.
Facebook SDK login → @kit.AccountKit (HUAWEI ID OAuth). No direct Facebook login on HarmonyOS; social login flows require full reimplementation.
Facebook iOS SDK → @kit.AccountKit. Auth only; Facebook Graph API calls need a backend proxy. Analytics and sharing features not available natively.
Adjust install attribution → @kit.AnalyticsKit. Install tracking, event attribution, and deep link measurement available via AGC Analytics.
AppsFlyer → @kit.AnalyticsKit. Install attribution and in-app events map to HiAppEvent; AGC Analytics provides equivalent functionality.
Braze push and in-app messaging → @kit.PushKit + @kit.NotificationKit. Rich notification and in-app message UI must be rebuilt for HarmonyOS.
BrazeKit (Braze Swift SDK) → @kit.PushKit. Same mapping as legacy Braze framework; push + in-app messaging need HarmonyOS rebuild.
OneSignal → @kit.PushKit. Token registration, notification click handlers, segmentation map well to HarmonyOS PushKit APIs.
Stripe → @kit.PaymentKit (HUAWEI Pay). Card tokenization, 3DS, payment sheet UI available; Stripe server-side component remains unchanged.
RevenueCat IAP → @kit.IAPKit. Subscription products, purchase verification, and entitlement management all available in HUAWEI IAPKit.
AdMob → @kit.AdsKit (HUAWEI Ads). Banner, interstitial, rewarded, and native ad formats all supported by HUAWEI Ads Kit.
AppLovin MAX → @kit.AdsKit. HUAWEI Ads mediation adapters available for major networks; waterfall configuration differs.
ironSource mediation → @kit.AdsKit. Ad serving APIs map; adapt network adapter configuration to HUAWEI Ads mediation.
Unity Ads rewarded/interstitial → @kit.AdsKit. Rewarded ad flow is identical in concept; placement IDs and callbacks need remapping.
AWS S3 → AGC Cloud Storage (@kit.CloudFoundationKit). Upload, download, and presigned URL logic must be rewritten for AGC APIs.
AWS iOS SDK core → no direct HMOS equivalent. Migrate backend calls to AGC or retain a custom server layer for AWS services.
Google Sign-In OAuth → @kit.AccountKit (HUAWEI ID). ID token flow, profile scopes, and silent sign-in all available.
Sign in with Apple → @kit.AccountKit (HUAWEI ID). Anonymous email relay not available; use standard HUAWEI ID authorization flow.
Branch attribution + deep links → @kit.AnalyticsKit + AGC App Linking. Custom URI schemes and App Links replace Branch links.
Mixpanel product analytics → @kit.AnalyticsKit. Event tracking, user profiles, and funnel analysis maps to AGC Analytics.
Amplitude product analytics → @kit.AnalyticsKit. Event ingestion, session tracking, and cohort analysis maps to HiAppEvent.
Segment CDP → @kit.AnalyticsKit. Event forwarding pipeline must be rebuilt; replace Segment destinations with native AGC integrations.
TFLite on-device inference → @kit.MindSporeLiteKit. Model conversion (.tflite → .ms) required; inference API is structurally similar.
TFLite Swift API → @kit.MindSporeLiteKit. Model conversion needed (.tflite → .ms); GPU and NNAPI delegates available on HarmonyOS.
iOS Keychain → @kit.UniversalKeystoreKit (HUKS). Key generation, secure storage, and AES/RSA crypto operations all available.
Sentry crash/error monitoring → @kit.PerformanceAnalysisKit. Exception capture, breadcrumbs, and performance tracing via HiAppEvent SDK.
FirebaseFirestoreInternal (internal Firestore Swift PM target) → @kit.ArkData. NoSQL cloud sync → relational/cloud storage; full data layer migration required.
Google App Measurement (Firebase Analytics backend) → @kit.AnalyticsKit (HiAppEvent). Session, event, and user-property measurement map directly.
Google identity support for App Measurement → @kit.AnalyticsKit. User-identity stitching handled via AGC Analytics user ID APIs.
Abseil C++ (absl) has no direct HarmonyOS equivalent. Replace with HarmonyOS NDK libc++ or equivalent STL containers/algorithms; assess usage per component.
gRPC over HTTP/2 → @kit.NetworkKit WebSocket or HTTP/2 requests. No native gRPC runtime on HarmonyOS; evaluate protobuf-over-HTTP or a gRPC-Web proxy.
gRPC C++ (grpcpp) → @kit.NetworkKit. Same migration path as grpc core: replace with HTTP/2 or WebSocket transport via NetworkKit.
OpenSSL bundled by gRPC → @kit.CryptoArchitectureKit (HUKS / HarmonyOS TLS stack). TLS channel security and certificate handling are provided by the platform.
